official_sources.title: Chapter 2.2 — Fats, Oils and Fat Emulsions, Version 5 (01.08.2025)
Chapter 2.2 — Fats, Oils and Fat Emulsions, Version 4 (07.05.2025)
Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Amendment Regulations, 2024 — 2.2.9 Corn (Maize) Oil substitution

common_rules.text: Oils and fats covered by Chapter 2.2 must comply with the applicable fatty-acid-composition table where listed.
Apply the product-specific peroxide-value limits in clause 2.2.8 to oils and fats where applicable.
Where Chapter 2.2 prescribes a trans-fat limit for the product, the current maximum is 2% by weight.
Food additives are permitted only as provided by the applicable Chapter 2.2 clause and Appendix A.

standards.name: Refined Vegetable Oil
standards.definition: Vegetable oil obtained by expression or solvent extraction and refined by the processes permitted in clause 2.2.1(16).
process_rules: Must be obtained from vegetable oils standardized in the regulations.
Permitted refining steps include deacidification/physical or miscella refining, permitted degumming, bleaching and steam deodorisation as specified in the clause.
No chemical agent other than those permitted by the clause may be used.
quality_rules: Clear and free from rancidity, adulterants, sediments, suspended/foreign matter, separated water, added colouring/flavouring substances and mineral oil.
label_rules: Clearly specify the name of the vegetable oil from which the refined oil was manufactured.
inheritance: The standards for the specified source edible oil also apply, except the refined-oil acid-value limit in 2.2.1(16) governs.

standards.name: Rapeseed or Mustard Oil — Low Erucic Acid
standards.note: Source-oil identity standard retained; refined variants inherit the refined vegetable oil requirements.

standards.name: Safflower Seed Oil — High Oleic / Imported
standards.note: Source-oil identity standard retained; refined variants inherit the refined vegetable oil requirements.

standards.name: Palm Kernel Olein
standards.definition: Liquid fraction obtained by fractionation of palm kernel oil from Elaeis guinensis.

composition.parameter: Free fatty acid as lauric acid

process_rules: Where obtained by solvent extraction, and for imported oil as specified, human-consumption supply requires refining to 2.2.1(16).
Refined oil must meet the applicable hexane and flash-point requirements in the clause.

standards.name: Grapeseed Oil
standards.definition: Oil expressed from clean and sound grape seeds (Vitis vinifera L.).
process_rules: If obtained by solvent extraction, it must be supplied for human consumption only after refining and conform to 2.2.1(16).
Refined solvent-extracted oil must meet the applicable hexane requirement; expelled-pressed oil must be free from hexane residues.

standards.name: Moringa Oil
standards.definition: Oil obtained by expressing clean and sound Moringa oleifera seed.

standards.name: Partially hydrogenated and winterised soyabean oil
aliases: Partially Hydrogenated and Winterised Soybean Oil
Partially hydrogenated and winterised soybean oil
standards.definition: Deodorised product obtained by light (mild or Brush) hydrogenation of degummed, deacidified, decolourised and winterised soyabean oil, with the processing steps specified by FSSAI.
quality_rules: Product shall be clear and free from rancidity, suspended or other foreign matter, separated water, added colouring or flavouring substances, castor oil, mineral oil, and other vegetable and animal fats.
Test for argemone oil shall be negative.

If obtained by solvent extraction, and for imported oil whether obtained by solvent extraction or otherwise, supply for human consumption only after refining in accordance with 2.2.1(16); refined oil shall not contain hexane above 5 ppm.
standards.additives: Food additives permitted in the Regulations and Appendices may be used.

standards.name: Partially hydrogenated soyabean oil
standards.definition: Deodorised product obtained by light (mild or brush) hydrogenation of degummed, deacidified and decolourised soyabean oil, followed by the further deacidification, bleaching and deodorisation steps specified by FSSAI.
quality_rules: Product shall be a clear liquid at 35°C; on melting it shall be clear and free from rancidity, suspended or other foreign matter, separated water, added colouring or flavouring substances, castor oil, mineral oil or other vegetable and animal oils and fats.
Test for argemone oil shall be negative.
Edible oils prescribed under 2.2.1 shall be free from castor oil.

If obtained by solvent extraction, and for imported oil whether obtained by solvent extraction or otherwise, supply for human consumption only after refining in accordance with 2.2.1(16); refined oil shall not contain hexane above 5 ppm.
standards.additives: Food additives permitted in the Regulations and Appendices may be used.

standards.name: Table Margarine
standards.definition: Emulsion of edible oils and fats with water.

composition.parameter: Free fatty acids as oleic acid

special_rules: Must contain sesame oil in the amount required for the prescribed Baudouin-test response.
Coloured/flavoured margarine must contain starch 100–150 ppm.
Coloured/flavoured margarine is to be sold only in sealed packages not exceeding 500 g.

standards.name: Bakery and Industrial Margarine
standards.definition: Emulsion of vegetable oil product with water.

composition.parameter: Free fatty acids as oleic acid

special_rules: Unsaponifiable matter generally not more than 2.0%; where rice bran oil exceeds 30% by weight, up to 2.5% is permitted subject to the prescribed declaration.

standards.name: Fat Spread
standards.definition: Water-in-oil emulsion with an aqueous phase and a fat phase of edible oils and fats, excluding animal body fats.

composition.parameter: Vegetable fat spread melting point of extracted fat

composition.unit: IU synthetic vitamin A/g at packing

composition.parameter: Trans fatty acids — mixed/vegetable fat spread

label_rules: For mixed fat spread, also declare milk fat content.
Do not associate the word 'butter' with the product.
packaging_rules: Compulsorily sold in sealed packages not exceeding 500 g under the prescribed Agmark requirement.

standards.name: Solvent Extracted Crude Vegetable Oils (not for direct human consumption)
standards.definition: Vegetable oils extracted using food grade hexane from sources mentioned in standards of respective edible oils under sub-regulation 2.2.1.
quality_rules: Oil shall be clear and free from rancidity, adulterants, sediment, suspended and other foreign matter, separated water, added colouring and flavouring substances, and Argemone oil.
process_rules: These oils as such are not for direct human consumption.
Before human consumption they shall be refined and conform to the standards for refined vegetable oils under clause 16 of regulation 2.2.1.

variants.name: Corn (Maize) Oil
variants.source_note: Current Version 4 incorporates the 2024 notified substitution.

standards.name: Interesterified Vegetable Fat/Oil
standards.definition: Edible fatty material treated to rearrange fatty-acid positions within glycerides by interesterification of essentially neutral edible oil or fat, singly or in mixtures, using permitted enzymatic or alkaline-catalyst processes followed by the specified post-process steps.
process_rules: Interesterification may use an enzymatic process or alkaline catalysts such as sodium or potassium metals or their ethoxides/hydroxides as provided in the standard.
Post-process steps include washing, bleaching and deodorisation, subject to the standard.
quality_rules: Product shall be clear and free from soap, flavouring substances, rancidity, suspended/foreign matter, separated water and mineral oil.

linked_rules.processing_aids: Appendix C Table 2 catalyst permissions apply only to the specified product category and residue limit.

standards.name: Hydrogenated Vegetable Oils
standards.definition: Hydrogenated vegetable oils include Vanaspati prepared from permitted edible vegetable oils by hydrogenation and the bakery-shortening variant specified in this clause.

product_variants.note: Bakery shortening is Vanaspati intended for shortening/leavening use in bakery manufacture and follows the Vanaspati standard with the clause-specific exceptions.

linked_rules.processing_aids: Appendix C Table 2 catalyst permissions for Hydrogenated vegetable oil require the corresponding exact product identity.
